## FMV home per collection (the recurring footgun)

| Collection | Live FMV home | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NBA Top Shot, NFL All Day, LaLiga Golazos, UFC Strike | `fmv_snapshots` (uuid `edition_id` → `editions.id`) | partitioned by year |
| Disney Pinnacle | `pinnacle_catalog.fmv_*` (current, render-keyed) + `pinnacle_fmv_history` (history) | engine `pinnacle-2.0.0-render` |

- `pinnacle_fmv_snapshots` **DOES NOT EXIST** (dropped 2026-06-08). A query against it
  `42P01`-errors. Only the frozen `pinnacle_fmv_snapshots_backup_20260608` survives. Do not
  reference `pinnacle_fmv_snapshots` in any query, doc, or skill.
- `pinnacle_catalog` FMV columns (verified live): `fmv_usd, fmv_wap_usd, fmv_confidence,
  fmv_computed_at, fmv_algo_version, fmv_days_since_sale, fmv_sales_count_7d,
  fmv_sales_count_30d, fmv_liquidity_rating`.

## Regeneration SQL (read-only)

```sql
-- FMV-home table existence
SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'
  AND tablename = ANY (ARRAY['pinnacle_fmv_snapshots','pinnacle_fmv_snapshots_backup_20260608',
    'pinnacle_fmv_history','pinnacle_catalog','fmv_snapshots']) ORDER BY tablename;

-- pinnacle_catalog FMV columns
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='pinnacle_catalog' AND column_name LIKE 'fmv%' ORDER BY 1;

-- enums
SELECT t.typname, array_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder)
  FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_enum e ON e.enumtypid=t.oid
  WHERE t.typname IN ('fmv_confidence','tier_type','chain_type','edition_kind') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- RLS posture
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public') AS public_tables,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND rowsecurity=false) AS rls_off_count,
       (SELECT array_agg(tablename ORDER BY tablename) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND rowsecurity=false) AS rls_off_tables;

-- collections registry
SELECT id, slug, name, chain FROM public.collections ORDER BY slug;

-- existence sweep for every table CLAUDE.md names (edit the VALUES list to match the doc)
WITH named(t) AS (VALUES ('editions'),('pinnacle_editions'),('wallet_moments_cache'),('fmv_snapshots'),
  ('sales'),('badge_editions'),('flowty_transactions'),('players'),('sets'),('linked_accounts'),
  ('collections'),('pinnacle_sales'),('pinnacle_catalog'),('pinnacle_fmv_history'),('moments'),
  ('pipeline_runs'),('topshot_moment_subeditions'),('unmapped_sales'))
SELECT n.t, (p.tablename IS NOT NULL) AS exists FROM named n
  LEFT JOIN pg_tables p ON p.schemaname='public' AND p.tablename=n.t ORDER BY exists, n.t;
```
